title: Kuromi Night In
description: A Kuromi night in for grown ups: the Kuromi and My Melody lavender pajama set, a Kuromi stars cardigan, Kuromi clogs, a quilted Kuromi throw, a purple Kuromi tumbler and the Pastel Florals plush.
intro: Kuromi is the Sanrio girl for women who are a little bit sweet and a little bit done with everyone. Purple, black, a pink skull and an attitude. This is the night in she would plan: lavender pajamas, a cardigan covered in her face, clogs with charms, a quilted throw, a tumbler for the cocoa and one plush who gets the good pillow. Six finds, all officially licensed and all on Amazon.

sections.heading: Start with the pajamas
paragraphs: The Bioworld Kuromi and My Melody set is a lavender tee with the two of them on a cloud, and black pants printed with Kuromi and a diamond pattern, finished with a pink drawstring. Grown-up sizes, soft, and cute enough to answer the door in.

sections.heading: The cardigan is the statement
paragraphs: Lavender knit, giant black Kuromi faces, white stars, black trim and black pockets. Over the pajamas it is a night-in outfit. Over a black tee and jeans it is a whole personality at the grocery store.

sections.heading: The cosy extras
paragraphs: The Northwest quilted throw is 60 by 80 inches, black with an all-over Kuromi print, and big enough to wrap up in on the floor. The Get Trend 30 oz tumbler is purple damask with a winking Kuromi and a carry handle. The Jazwares Pastel Florals plush is 8 inches, with flowers on her ears and a pastel skirt.
The clogs are black platforms with lavender insoles, a hot pink Kuromi strap with skulls and a set of character charms. Indoor, outdoor, school run. Nobody is stopping you.

sections.heading: What is real and what is styling
paragraphs: The six finds are the pajama set, the cardigan, the clogs, the throw, the tumbler and the plush. The rug, daybed, quilt, pillows, fairy lights, lamp, books, pouf, cocoa, floor cushion and the dog are styling extras.
Photos are AI-generated styling ideas, so check each listing for the exact item, colour and size before you buy.
